theorems.name: Submission.cmc_rcc_ae_tendsto_measure_superlevel
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → limsup (fun j => μs j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → (∀ G : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen G → G ⊆ U → μ G ≤ liminf (fun j => μs j G) atTop) → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))), Tendsto (fun j => μs j {x | t < g x}) atTop (𝓝 (μ {x | t < g x}))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
